Eine Instanz = ein Messort. Für einen we: One instance = one measurement location. For another location (e.g. a holiday apartment), create a second instance. Only coordinates, measured values and device model are transmitted – no device identifiers, meter numbers or IP addresses.

Je Messgröße können mehrere Datenpunkte: Multiple data points can be entered per measured variable. On each upload, the first one in table order whose value is fresh and plausible wins (voltage 150–300 V, frequency 45–55 Hz). Phases without a data point are sent as "not measured" (-1) – so for single-phase measurement, enter only L1.
